lines.en: label mall20:
scene mall2
I show up at the mall around the usual time and head directly over to Chika’s store when I notice she’s not on her normal bench.
lines.zh: 我照常在差不多的时间来到商场，发现 Chika 不在她平时的长椅上，就直接往她店里去了。

lines.en: The only issue is...she’s not at the store either.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是……她也不在店里。

lines.en: Instead, some random girl around the same age as me is. Chika’s manager, maybe?
lines.zh: 取而代之的是个跟我年纪相仿的陌生女孩。也许是 Chika 的店长？

lines.en: Either way, I'm forced to look around the store for a few minutes so that it doesn't seem like I'm just some random guy who came in looking for a specific [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我被迫在店里逛了几分钟，免得看起来像个专程进来找某个[teenage]女孩的怪男人。

lines.en: And {i}now{/i} I’m forced to look around the mall to find Chika...if she’s even here.
lines.zh: 而{i}现在{/i}我被迫在整个商场里找 Chika……如果她真的在这儿的话。

lines.en: scene black
scene mall1
: Huh...No Chika anywhere to be found.
lines.zh: : 嗯……到处都找不到 Chika。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just off today?
lines.zh: : 也许她今天休息？

lines.en: Chika having the day off is a thought that never even crossed my mind.
lines.zh: 「Chika 今天休息」这个念头，我从来没想过。

lines.en: I mean, she’s been here virtually every weekend since I woke up in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我是说，自从我在 Kumon-mi 醒来之后，她几乎每个周末都在这儿。

lines.en: But I guess that even scripted events sometimes-
lines.zh: 不过我想，就算是脚本事件，有时候也-

lines.en: : Okay, Chinami. Remember what I told you?
lines.zh: : 好的，Chinami。还记得我跟你说过什么吗？

lines.en: : Hm?
scene chinamisphone1
: No talking to strangers!
lines.zh: : 不许跟陌生人说话！

lines.en: : Good girl. And what else?
lines.zh: : 好孩子。还有呢？

lines.en: : No microtransactions!
lines.zh: : 不许内购！

lines.en: : What’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 这是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone2
: Hm? What do you-
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么意思-

lines.en: scene chinamisphone3
: Oh, Sensei! I didn’t expect to see you here so late in the day.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！没想到这天都快黑了还能在这儿碰到你。

lines.en: : Late in the day? It’s basically the same time it always is when I show up.
lines.zh: : 天快黑了？我来的时间跟平时基本一样啊。

lines.en: : That’s not true. It’s like, almost thirty minutes later.
lines.zh: : 不对。都晚了快三十分钟了。

lines.en: : That’s only because I’ve been scouring the place looking for you.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我为了找你把这地方翻了个遍。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone4
: Oh, crap! I totally forgot to tell you I have the day off today.
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了！我完全忘了跟你说我今天休息。

lines.en: : If you have the day off, what are you doing at the mall?
lines.zh: : 既然你休息，那你来商场干嘛？

lines.en: : Chinami is getting a phone!
lines.zh: : Chinami 要买手机啦！

lines.en: scene chinamisphone5
: Yup. Just like she said, I caved and I’m letting her get a phone.
lines.zh: : 对。就像她说的，我让步了，要给她买个手机。

lines.en: : She’s been having to stay at home alone a lot more lately and I figured it would be good for her to be able to keep in touch with me at all times of the day.
lines.zh: : 最近她一个人在家的时候越来越多了，我想让她能随时联系上我会比较好。

lines.en: : Especially since our house-phone was just deactivated and stuff.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我们家座机刚被停机了什么的。

lines.en: : Deactivated? Why?
lines.zh: : 停机？为什么？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone6
: Money, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是钱啊。

lines.en: : Adults have so many bills that it’s kinda hard to keep up with all of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 大人的账单多到有点顾不过来。

lines.en: : So when I missed the payment for the landline I figured I could just add Chinami to my cell-plan.
lines.zh: : 所以固话的账单我漏缴了，我想干脆把 Chinami 加到我的手机套餐里。

lines.en: I figured it was something along those lines. I honestly feel a little foolish for even asking.
lines.zh: 我猜就是这类原因。说实话，我甚至觉得自己问这话有点蠢。

lines.en: It makes sense that she’s not able to keep up with all of her bills just working part-time at a boutique in the mall.
lines.zh: 她只在商场的精品店打零工，跟不上所有账单也很正常。

lines.en: Hell, it would probably be hard no matter how many hours she worked here every week.
lines.zh: 见鬼，不管她每周在这儿干多少小时，大概都很难。

lines.en: : How much is it to add Chinami to your plan?
lines.zh: : 把 Chinami 加到你的套餐里要多少钱？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone7
: I looked it up online and I think it was somewhere around another 4,000 yen. And I imagine that will go up a bit after convenience fees or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我在网上查了，大概又得 4000 日元左右。我想加上手续费什么的还会再涨一点。

lines.en: : And you’re able to afford that?
lines.zh: : 你付得起吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone6
: I don’t really have a choice. It’s either fork over another 4,000 yen or leave my sister high and dry in the event of an emergency.
lines.zh: : 我也没得选。要么再掏 4000 日元，要么万一家里有急事，就只能把我妹妹晾在那儿。

lines.en: : ...What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : ……什么？你干嘛这么看着我？

lines.en: I think it’s time to activate good-person mode for the week.
lines.zh: 我想，是时候开启本周的好人模式了。

lines.en: I figure I might as well get my one good deed out of the way while I have the chance to.
lines.zh: 我想，不如趁现在把这一周的好事给做了。

lines.en: : Chika.
lines.zh: : Chika。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : Let me pay your phone bill from now on.
lines.zh: : 从现在起，让我来替你付电话费吧。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone8
: What?! Absolutely not. There’s no way I could let you do something like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？！绝对不行。我怎么能让你做这种事。

lines.en: : Why not? I make significantly more money than you.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？我挣的钱比你多得多。

lines.en: : Well, duh. You’re a teacher and I’m a [teenage]girl working at the mall.
lines.zh: : 废话。你是老师，我是个在商场打工的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean you should be friggin’ payin’ my bills for me and stuff.
lines.zh: : 可那也不代表你该替我付账单什么的啊。

lines.en: : Just think of it as an early Christmas present or something.
lines.zh: : 就当是提前送的圣诞礼物什么的。

lines.en: : What kind of crazy Christmas present is a whole friggin’ phone plan?
lines.zh: : 哪个疯子会把一整个手机套餐当圣诞礼物啊？

lines.en: : Chinami likes this idea!
lines.zh: : Chinami 喜欢这个主意！

lines.en: scene chinamisphone9
: Chinami, you stay out of this. This is between me and Sensei.
lines.zh: : Chinami，你别插嘴。这是我和 Sensei 之间的事。

lines.en: : Woof!
scene chinamisphone10
Chinami barks and sends Chika into emotional overload as she shows a rare moment of defeat, taking a deep breath as she closes her eyes.
lines.zh: Chinami 叫了一声，把 Chika 的情绪直接冲爆，她罕见地露出认输的表情，闭上眼睛深吸了一口气。

lines.en: : Listen...I’m flattered that you would even offer something like that...But this is {i}my{/i} problem.
lines.zh: : 听着……你会提出这种事，我已经很受宠若惊了……但这是{i}我{/i}的问题。

lines.en: : And besides, I’m already paying for half of Yumi’s bill as well. She’s on my plan, too.
lines.zh: : 而且，Yumi 的账单我也已经付一半了。她也在我的套餐里。

lines.en: : Yeah, an extra 4,000 yen a month is kind of rough for me, but I’ll figure something out.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一个月多 4000 日元对我来说确实挺吃力，但我会想办法的。

lines.en: : Why are you even trying to argue this? I’ve already made my decision.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛还要跟我争？我已经决定了。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone11
: Your decision sucks. And it’ll make me feel like, a trillion times worse about everything.
lines.zh: : 你的决定糟透了。而且会让我对所有事的感觉都糟上一万亿倍。

lines.en: : There’s literally nothing I’d be able to do to pay you back.
lines.zh: : 我根本没有办法回报你。

lines.en: : You don’t need to pay me back. I wouldn’t be offering this if I didn’t want to do it.
lines.zh: : 你不需要回报我。如果不是心甘情愿，我不会提出来的。

lines.en: Plus...there’s absolutely no way I could put Chinami in a situation like that.
lines.zh: 而且……我绝对不可能让 Chinami 陷入那种境地。

lines.en: If she’s going to be alone, I’d be a lot more comfortable knowing she has a reliable service plan.
lines.zh: 既然她要一个人待着，知道她有个可靠的通讯套餐，我会放心得多。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone12
: Sensei...It’s fine. Really. I’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : Sensei……没事的。真的。我会想办法。

lines.en: : I’ve already figured it out. I’ll pay for you, Chinami, {i}and{/i} Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我已经想好了。我会替你、Chinami，{i}还有{/i} Yumi 付。

lines.en: : I’m already paying for Ami’s bill. A few more won’t make much of a difference to me, but it’s a world of difference to you.
lines.zh: : Ami 的账单我已经在付了。多加几个对我来说差别不大，但对你来说就是天壤之别。

lines.en: : Use that money to buy more food or something. You guys deserve it.
lines.zh: : 拿那笔钱多买点吃的什么的。你们值得。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone13
: Stop trying to be so cool in front of my little sister.
lines.zh: : 别在我妹妹面前耍帅了。

lines.en: : I’m trying to be cool in front of you, too, you know.
lines.zh: : 我也想在你面前耍帅啊。

lines.en: : I already think you’re really cool, though.
lines.zh: : 可我本来就觉得你很帅了。

lines.en: : But I bet you think I’m even cooler now, right?
lines.zh: : 但我猜你现在觉得我更帅了，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know. What do you think?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she doesn’t care who pays! She just wants a phone!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得她不在乎谁付钱！她只想要手机！

lines.en: : Quiet, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Chinami。

lines.en: : Woof!
scene chinamisphone14
: You’re really okay with doing something like this for me?
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意为我做这种事？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : And you’re not gonna try and extort me for something or whatever, right?
lines.zh: : 而且你不会借此勒索我什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...That wasn’t something I was planning on, no.
lines.zh: : 呃……我没打算那么做，不会。

lines.en: : And Yumi, too?
lines.zh: : 那 Yumi 也算？

lines.en: : Yumi, too.
lines.zh: : Yumi 也算。

lines.en: : It would probably be best not to tell her about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过最好别告诉她。

lines.en: : I feel like she’d throw her phone into the river if she found out I was the one paying for it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她要是知道是我付的钱，会直接把手机扔进河里。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone15
: That’s sad because it’s true.
lines.zh: : 这话说得可真悲哀，因为是事实。

lines.en: : It really is...
lines.zh: : 确实是……

lines.en: scene chinamisphone16
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Chinami, can you cover your ears for a second?
lines.zh: : Chinami，你能捂一下耳朵吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone17
: Chinami isn’t sure if this will do anything, but she will listen to her sister!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不确定这样做有没有用，但她会听姐姐的话！

lines.en: : Good girl, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 好孩子，Chinami。

lines.en: : Woof!
: Sensei. Can you come here for a sec?
lines.zh: : Sensei。你能过来一下吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone18
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Are you really sure you’re okay with this?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定没问题吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : And you don’t expect anything in return?
lines.zh: : 而且你不图任何回报？

lines.en: : Nope. Just doing my good deed for the week.
lines.zh: : 不图。就当是我这周做的好事。

lines.en: : I think a deed this good counts for the whole year.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这么好的事，够抵一整年了。

lines.en: : That’s even better. It means I can go back to being an asshole again after this.
lines.zh: : 那更好。这意味着过了这阵我又能回去当混蛋了。

lines.en: : Hahaha, yeah, I guess it does.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈，是啊，大概吧。

lines.en: : So, I’m assuming the store right behind you is the one where-
lines.zh: : 那么，我猜你身后那家店就是-

lines.en: scene chinamisphone19
: Oh! Umm, one more thing.
lines.zh: : 哦！嗯，还有一件事。

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: scene chinamisphone20
: Are we like, allowed to kiss in public yet? Or is that still a no-go?
lines.zh: : 我们……现在可以在公开场合接吻了吗？还是说这事依然不行？

lines.en: : Cause I kinda wanna squeeze the life out of you right now and stuff.
lines.zh: : 因为我现在有点想把你勒得喘不过气来什么的。

lines.en: I take a quick look around the mall to find that it’s actually rather busy today.
lines.zh: 我快速环顾了一下商场，发现今天其实挺热闹的。

lines.en: And apart from Chika being my student, there’s still a considerable age gap between us.
lines.zh: 而且除了 Chika 是我的学生之外，我们之间还有相当大的年龄差距。

lines.en: I can’t imagine something like kissing her in broad daylight {i}not{/i} attracting attention to us, so...
lines.zh: 我想象不出在大白天吻她{i}不{/i}引来注意的样子，所以……

lines.en: : I don’t think we should just yet...
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在还不行……

lines.en: scene chinamisphone21
: Yeeeeah, I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 是————啊，我就知道会这样。

lines.en: : I’ll just have to make it up to you some other time then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我只好改天用别的方式补偿你了，是吧？

lines.en: : The whole sticking your tongue out thing makes that seem pretty suggestive, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你吐舌头那一下，让这话听起来相当有暗示性啊，Chika。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone22
: Oh? Does it?
lines.zh: : 哦？是吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I should be a little more careful with my expressions then?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该更小心一点自己的表情？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t want you thinking I’m {i}suggesting{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 我可不想让你觉得我在{i}暗示{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Chinami’s arms are getting tired. Can we buy her a phone now?
lines.zh: : Chinami 的手举累了。我们现在能给她买手机了吗？

lines.en: : Let’s continue this some other time.
lines.zh: : 这个我们改天再继续。

lines.en: : Heheh...sure~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……好呀~

lines.en: scene black
The three of us enter the cell-phone store and let Chinami pick out whichever phone she wants.
lines.zh: 我们三个人走进手机店，让 Chinami 自己挑她想要的手机。

lines.en: Fortunately, she winds up choosing an older model that isn’t extremely expensive, and after signing a few forms, she’s ready to go.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，她最后选了一台不算太贵的旧款，签了几张表之后，她就可以走了。

lines.en: Chika hugs me from behind at the checkout counter while the clerk is distracted filling things out and whispers her thanks to me once again.
lines.zh: 在收银台前，趁着店员低头填东西，Chika 从背后抱住我，又一次小声向我道谢。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone23
: At last! Chinami’s true power can now be unleashed!
lines.zh: : 终于！Chinami 真正的力量可以解放了！

lines.en: Chinami holds the key to her true power (IE: A cell phone) above her head and screams loud enough for the entire mall to hear.
lines.zh: Chinami 把她真正力量的钥匙（也就是：一部手机）高举过头顶，尖叫得整个商场都听得见。

lines.en: She’s so happy that neither of us have the heart to tell her to stop, though.
lines.zh: 不过她太开心了，我们俩谁都不忍心叫她停下来。

lines.en: : Remember to take good care of that, Chinami. Sensei bought it for you, so you need to be super careful to not break it.
lines.zh: : 记得好好爱护它，Chinami。这是 Sensei 给你买的，所以你要非常小心，别弄坏了。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone24
: Chinami will be very careful. She will protect this phone with her life.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会非常小心的。她会用生命保护这部手机。

lines.en: : Good girl, now thank Sensei or I’m going to take it away.
lines.zh: : 好孩子，现在谢谢 Sensei，不然我就把它没收了。

lines.en: : Thank you Sensei! Chinami will never forget this moment! Not even when you become her new daddy!
lines.zh: : 谢谢 Sensei！Chinami 永远不会忘记这一刻！就算你变成她的新爸爸也不会！

lines.en: scene chinamisphone25
: Hey, Chinami! No one is becoming anyone’s new daddy!
lines.zh: : 喂，Chinami！谁也不会变成谁的新爸爸！

lines.en: : What is Chinami’s phone number? She wants to make her first friend.
lines.zh: : Chinami 的电话号码是多少？她想交第一个朋友。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone26
: Hm? You can’t give your number to Sensei, Chinami. He’s-
lines.zh: : 嗯？Chinami，你不能把号码给 Sensei。他是-

lines.en: : I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我不介意。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone27
: Wait, what? I don’t even have your number yet and you’re going to give it to my little sister? She doesn’t even know how to use a phone yet.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我还没给你我的号码呢，你就要把它给我妹妹？她连手机都还不会用。

lines.en: : Lies. Chinami has destroyed many pigs in the bird-game. She is a master of the phone.
lines.zh: : 谎话。Chinami 在打鸟游戏里消灭过很多猪。她是手机大师。

lines.en: : Give me your number then. And besides, wouldn’t it be good for me to have Chinami’s number in case there’s ever some sort of emergency?
lines.zh: : 那把你的号码给我。再说，万一有什么紧急情况，我有 Chinami 的号码不是更好吗？

lines.en: : Well, yeah but...It still seems kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，话是这么说，可是……总感觉有点怪。

lines.en: : It’s not weird at all, I promise.
lines.zh: : 一点都不怪，我保证。

lines.en: scene chinamisphone28
: Well...if you insist...I guess there's no fighting it.
lines.zh: : 那……既然你坚持……看来是拗不过你了。

lines.en: : I’m more than happy to give you my number, at the very least...
lines.zh: : 至少，我很乐意把我的号码给你……

lines.en: scene black
Chika walks over to me and swipes my phone out of my hand, entering hers and Chinami’s phone numbers into it with lightning-quick speed.
lines.zh: Chika 走过来，一把抽走我手里的手机，以闪电般的速度把她和 Chinami 的号码输了进去。

lines.en: I expected no less from the cell-phone goddess of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 不愧是 Kumon-mi 的手机女神，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: Chika hands my phone back to me and I find that she’s added a heart next to it and...
lines.zh: Chika 把手机还给我，我发现她在自己号码旁边加了个爱心，还有……

lines.en: And a dog emoji next to Chinami’s...
lines.zh: 在 Chinami 的号码旁边加了个狗的表情符号……

lines.en: $ chikanumber = True
$ chinaminumber = True
$ chika_love += 1
$ mall20 = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have the phone numbers of the Chosokabe sisters!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在拥有 Chosokabe 姐妹的电话号码了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Feel free to call them after[school] and on weekends to see what they’re up to!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎在[school]之后和周末打电话给她们，看看她们在干什么！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
